cards.ex: Although they are siblings, they are alike in many ways; they both love music and art.
cards.exUz: Ular aka-uka bo'lishsa ham, ko'p jihatdan o'xshash; ikkalasi ham musiqa va san'atni yaxshi ko'radilar.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p narsalarda bir xil yoki o'xshash bo'lish.

cards.ex: My brother and I are cut from the same cloth; we both enjoy taking risks.
cards.exUz: Akam bilan men bir xil xamirdanmiz; ikkalamiz ham tavakkal qilishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Xarakterlari yoki odatlari bir xil bo'lgan odamlar.

cards.ex: Politically, my parents and I are poles apart; we rarely agree on anything.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy jihatdan ota-onam bilan butunlay boshqamiz; biz deyarli hech narsada kelishmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay farqli, hech qanday o'xshash tomoni yo'q.

cards.ex: There's a world of difference between liking someone and loving them.
cards.exUz: Kimnidir yoqtirish bilan sevish o'rtasida katta farq bor.

cards.ex: The second movie was made in a similar vein to the first, but it wasn't as good.
cards.exUz: Ikkinchi film birinchi filmga o'xshash ruhda suratga olingan, ammo u unchalik yaxshi emas edi.

cards.ex: The modern building stands in stark contrast to the historic architecture of the city.
cards.exUz: Zamonaviy bino shahar tarixiy me'morchiligi bilan keskin farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta farq bilan ajralib turmoq.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength; we just understand each other without speaking.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir to'lqindamiz; biz bir-birimizni gapirmasdan tushunamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: This small apartment is a far cry from the mansion they used to live in.
cards.exUz: Bu kichkina kvartira ular ilgari yashagan hashamatli uydan ancha farq qiladi.

cards.ex: The twins are a mirror image of each other; it's hard to tell them apart.
cards.exUz: Egizaklar bir-birining ko'zgu aksidir; ularni ajratish qiyin.

cards.ex: She bears a strong resemblance to her mother when she was younger.
cards.exUz: U yoshligida onasiga juda o'xshaydi.

cards.ex: He's cut from a different mold than most politicians; he actually cares about people.
cards.exUz: U ko'pchilik siyosatchilardan butunlay farq qiladi; u odamlarga chin dildan qayg'uradi.

cards.ex: Whether we take the bus or the train, it's the same difference; we'll still be late.
cards.exUz: Avtobusda boramizmi yoki poyezdda, farqi yo'q; baribir kechikamiz.

cards.ex: Their opinions on the matter were vastly different, leading to a heated debate.
cards.exUz: Ular fikrlari juda farqli edi, bu qizg'in bahsga olib keldi.

cards.ex: In contrast to her brother, she's very outgoing and social.
cards.exUz: Akasidan farqli o'laroq, u juda kirishimli va do'stlashuvchan.

cards.ex: He's very dedicated to his work, but on the flip side, he doesn't have much of a social life.
cards.exUz: U o'z ishiga juda sodiq, ammo boshqa tomondan, uning ijtimoiy hayoti unchalik emas.

cards.ex: This new phone is nothing like my old one; it's so much faster and easier to use.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi telefon mening eskisiga umuman o'xshamaydi; u ancha tezroq va ishlatish osonroq.

cards.ex: Those two are like two peas in a pod; they're always together.
cards.exUz: Ular ikki no'xat kabi; ular har doim birga bo'lishadi.

cards.ex: That's a different kettle of fish altogether; we need to discuss it separately.
cards.exUz: Bu butunlay boshqa masala; biz uni alohida muhokama qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: They have a lot in common with each other, which is why they get along so well.
cards.exUz: Ularning bir-biri bilan ko'p umumiy jihatlari bor, shuning uchun ular juda yaxshi kelishadilar.

cards.ex: This new restaurant is not a patch on the old one; the food is terrible.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi restoran eski restoran bilan yaqiniga ham kelmaydi; ovqat yomon.
cards.uzDef: Biroz ham yaxshiroq emas, hech qanday taqqoslashga arzimaydi.

cards.ex: We're thinking along the same lines; I had the same idea about the project.
cards.exUz: Biz shu kabi fikrlayapmiz; loyiha haqida men ham xuddi shunday fikrga ega edim.

cards.ex: His optimistic attitude contrasts sharply with her pessimistic outlook.
cards.exUz: Uning optimistik munosabati uning pessimistik qarashlari bilan keskin farq qiladi.

cards.ex: She looks for all the world like her mother when she was younger.
cards.exUz: U yoshligida go'yoki onasiga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shunday ko'rinadi yoki shunday tuyuladi.

cards.ex: You can't compare those two companies; it's like comparing apples and oranges.
cards.exUz: Bu ikki kompaniyani taqqoslay olmaysiz; bu olma va apelsinni taqqoslagandek.

cards.ex: They both share a common trait: a love of adventure.
cards.exUz: Ularning ikkalasi ham umumiy xususiyatga ega: sarguzashtga muhabbat.

cards.ex: Their lifestyles are worlds apart; she lives in the city, and he lives in the country.
cards.exUz: Ularning turmush tarzi olam-olam farq qiladi; u shaharda, u esa qishloqda yashaydi.

cards.ex: This type of tree is distinct from the others in the forest.
cards.exUz: Ushbu daraxt turi o'rmondagi boshqa daraxtlardan farqli.

cards.ex: I thought he was shy, but on the contrary, he's very outgoing.
cards.exUz: Men uni uyatchan deb o'yladim, lekin aksincha, u juda kirishimli.

cards.ex: Their approaches to solving the problem differ significantly.
cards.exUz: Muammoni hal qilish usullari sezilarli darajada farq qiladi.

cards.ex: The two restaurants are much the same; they both serve Italian food.
cards.exUz: Ikki restoran deyarli bir xil; ularning ikkalasi ham italyan taomlarini taklif qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Asosan bir xil, katta farq yo'q.
